edits.headline: EU announces plan to restrict social media for under-15s
edits.subheadline: BBC News reported on 17 September that the European Union plans to limit social media access for children under 15.
editorialBody: The European Union announced a plan to restrict social media access for children under 15, BBC News reported on 17 September.
The EU also wants to separate children from AI chatbots, Wired reported.

Russia will open 10 polling stations near its border crossings with Latvia, Lithuania, Estonia and Poland for parliamentary elections on 18 to 20 September, TASS reported. Central Election Commission chairwoman Ella Pamfilova said they were for Russian citizens living in those countries.
Lavrov said there was a massive wave of propaganda from the West ahead of the elections, TASS reported.

Stephen Lashbrook, 50, of Pensacola, Florida, told Fox News Digital that a meat-only "lion diet" cleared psoriasis covering 90% of his body and ended decades of depression. He started the diet on 1 January 2024.
A record number of university graduates pushed China's youth unemployment rate to 18.9%, the South China Morning Post reported.
Uganda's central bank raised its reserve requirement to defend the shilling, Bloomberg reported.
